and when he first cast division between its lord and his nobles.
For he used to write to him secretly,
saying: "Beware of the treachery of such and such persons,
because they are constantly sending to me offering to deliver Damascus to me;
and I do not judge it right that I should leave the Franks,
and fight with Muslims."
And while he deceived that wretched man with things like these,
he killed the commanders of his armies one by one.
And Nur al-Din, seeing that no one was left in Damascus who could oppose him,
went against it
and easily captured it.
And he gave to Mujir, its lord, some villages in the region of Homs,
and sent him there.
And he did good deeds for the people of Damascus,
and they rejoiced in him as one who was able to stand against the Franks.
And in this year, Zafir son of Hafiz, Caliph of Egypt, was killed,
and after him reigned Isa his little son, who was three years old,
and he was called Fa'iz.
And a man whose name was Abbas was his vizier.
And because the great emir Faris al-Din was not present,
he became enraged and threatened Abbas,
that he had acted without his counsel.
Now Abbas was afraid,
and took everything that he possessed,
and set out with three thousand Armenians of his service,
and began to flee and to take refuge with Nur al-Din.
And when the Egyptians pursued after him,
the Armenians turned back against them
and killed the majority of them.
And he and those who were with him traveled in the desert,
and they were tormented there for days by hunger and thirst,
because their guide deceived them,
as once happened to Julian the Apostate.
And when he brought them out towards Ascalon,
the Franks came out against them.
And when the Armenians saw the crosses on the heads of the Franks' spears,
they threw down their weapons
and mingled with them.
And on that day about five thousand Muslims were killed.
And that Shujir (Abbas?) was captured and sold by the Franks to the Egyptians, and they crucified him.
And in that same year the Caliph,
that is al-Muqtafi,
went and encamped against Tikrit,
and waged a fierce battle against it,
and destroyed the city completely,
and began to fight against its fortress.
